title: Manduka Prolite Yoga and Pilates Mat 4.7mm Thick, Non-Slip, Non-Toxic, Eco-Friendly, Long. Made with Dense Cushioning for Stability and Support

reviews.title: Love this mat!
reviews.body: I love this mat! I debated buying it because of the price, but it was definitely worth it. I chose the PROlite instead of the Pro because I practice at a studio 4-6 times per week and didn't want to lug around the heavy Pro.My favorite aspects of this mat are its density and support. My previous mat was a little thicker, less dense, and had more cushion. I liked this for my wrists and knees, and was worried the PROlite would not be as good in these areas. But it works great so far and I haven't had any problems with my wrists or knees. The mat is dense, so when I stand on it I have more support, which increases my balance in standing/balancing poses. My previous mat used to sink down and form an impression of my feet, but this mat does not do that and I have found my balance and steadiness has improved as a result. The size is also good for me (I'm 5'5").As for slipping, I don't have any complaints so far. I practice hot yoga (95 degree room) and for a normal effort class, I just wipe my hands a few times during class and I'm fine. If the class is really intense and I start dripping sweat, I put my hand towel down to use over the mat. With my previous mat I used a mat towel because I would slip all over the place. I've been using this mat for about 2 months, without doing the initial salt scrub & sun exposure to break it in. I find that for some reason my feet don't slip at all, ever. But if the class is really intense, my hands can start to slip.Overall, I really love this mat and am happy that I purchased it. I would definitely recommend it to someone who is looking to expand their yoga practice. I didn't realize how much my other mat was affecting my practice until I switched to the PROlite.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 10, 2016
reviews.author: Kristen Johnson

reviews.title: Excellent Mat with the Perfect Amount of Cushion and Support
reviews.body: Welcome to the wonderful world of Great Yoga Mat Ownership! I've owned a handful of middle-of-the-road mats but as I take my practice more seriously, I thought I would invest in a higher quality mat. Like a good shoe, the perfect mat is a delicate balance between cushion and support and the Manduka ProLite mat nailed it and delivered. I use this for Bikram Yoga (with a Youphoria yoga towel) and the high quality high density 1/4" thickness foam is great for keeping balance and not allowing your standing foot/leg to sink into the mat. Between the mat and the towel I haven't experienced any slipping yet. I highly recommend this mat. I've been using it ~3times/week for 2 weeks. So far no issues, wear, or funky smells.I bought this mat in Isabela and it is a beautiful and vivid in color. I absolutely adore it! I've also looked at some of the other colors and wish I could buy it in some other colors too, but at this price, I better not. :(I also bought the Manduka Mat Wash to keep it clean and in tip top condition. I spray and wipe it down after every use.It is a little on the heavy side so I would recommend using a mat strap to sling it (crossbody) over your back.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 24, 2016
reviews.author: Carolyn LaGreca

reviews.title: I REALLY wanted to love it :(
reviews.body: I REALLY wanted to love this mat :( i'm in love with the company and the colors are gorgeous, I love everything about Manduka, but this mat just didn't do it for me. I read the reviews and a bunch of people said they loved the mat and had their for ten years, which made me decide to go ahead and get one.I purchased the mat and initially it was awesome, SUPER firm, you can tell it will last forever and it was really sticky. BUT, if I sweat even a tad or if my palms just get a little sweaty, all of the stickiness disappears and this is essentially a slip n slide. I practice ashtanga and used everyday for about 6 months and still super slippery. I really love everything about manduka and this mat except the fact that it's too slippery, which ultimately renders it useless. The sea salt scrub worked in some way, it made it stickier, but only for about ten minutes, then back to the slip n slide. At one point, I contacted Manduka and they were so kind, asked me about the sea salt scrub and cleaning the mat, all of which I did, and they offered me a discount on a yoga towel which I purchased. this was fine for a while, but it gets annoying to have to constantly wash my towel after every practice and to have to bring it every day to practice. So, basically, the only way I can use my mat is if I use it with a towel on top, which seems really lame to me. It's pretty frustrating to spend so much on a mat and then have to "break it in", which never happened and after 6 months, im tired of waiting. It's very slippery, which makes the mat dangerous and I don't think I should have to risk injury just to break this in. For me, the final straw was when I decided that id like a yoga mat to keep at a studio and one for home, and I considered getting another manduka, but after 6 months, this one was still not "broken in".Maybe this mat works for some people and if it does, i'm really happy for you, but this just wasn't for me and I tried so hard and wanted so badly to love it. I ended up getting a lululemon The Mat and I really love it. not one issue.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 16, 2015
reviews.author: Grace Brock

reviews.title: worth the price!
reviews.body: This mat is great!  I teach PIYO Live and need a reliable mat that will hold up to multiple uses per week but still be easy enough to transport to and from the gym.  This one is great.  I love the color, the material seems very durable, and the mat does not slide around while I am teaching.  The one issue I have is that it does show some wear but it doesn't seem to be wearing through or getting worse - just normal use stuff.  And there is a warranty so I am really not worried about it too much.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 14, 2016
reviews.author: CSmith

reviews.title: YES!!! FINALLY!!!
reviews.body: Casual yoga practitioner(beginner gym/at home DVD) for 15+ years who got by with $20 cheapo mats finally bought a pro mat.  I researched the heck out of the ratings on Amazon and other sites for recommendations.  Bought a horrible MANSOV which could not even support a down dog without slipping.  The cheapo $20 mats were very "got what you paid for".  Good enough, but didn't last long.  HUGE DIFFERENCE with the Manduka PROLite.  So glad to see that the price tag wasn't just hype or paying for a brand name attached to a crappy mat.  I used sea salt to break it in as recommended, made a wash (water/vinegar/essential oil), cleaned the mat, and let dry.  Moment of truth... Is it sticky?  YES!!!  Love it!  Was a little concerned the "Lite" meant poor cushioning, but it doesn't.  I feel very supported on hands and knees.  After the wash, the mild chemical smell is gone.  After the salt scrub and wash, the mat increased in stickiness from when I first tried it out of the wrapping.  Great product!  Would but it again, but it comes with a lifetime warranty, so probably won't have to.  Plus, got an extra mat from a shipping error (ordered and paid for 1 but was sent 2).  Offered to send extra mat back, but seller said that I could keep it.  Great karma all around.  Thanks!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on February 26, 2017
reviews.author: Jen

reviews.title: Huge Disappointment
reviews.body: I am so disappointed with this mat, especially since it cost so much. This brand was recommended to me by my yoga teacher.  It is super-slippery.  The dirt from the studio floor sticks just fine, but my hands and feet do not.  Even after the recommended salt scrub (see the Manduka web site for this), I can't stay in a down dog without sliding, before starting to sweat. Manduka recommends using a towel if slipping is a problem, but I did not spend this much money on a mat to have to use a towel on it. I never had this problem with my cheap box store mat.  It is also more narrow and less cushioning than my old cheap mat, so I have to reposition myself often to stay on the mat when changing poses, and I am a small person.  The smell isn't overpowering, but it still has more of an odor than I thought it would. I am very sorry I bought this mat.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 27, 2016
reviews.author: Nutrimom

reviews.title: Better off with a Jade Harmony or Lululemon Reversible
reviews.body: This mat is rated very highly and came in  #1 in 2016 by one group of yogi's, so with so many endorsements I bought it.  I have to say I was less than thrilled with it  right out of the package as it was the most slippery mat I had every used (both in hot and regular hatha class).  The  mat does come with instructions on how to expedite the "break in" process, which involves scrubbing it with coarse salt and letting it bake in the sun, but really, should you have to got through all that just to use a yoga mat?  Since using it wasn't breaking it in fast enough,  I did finally try the salt/sun routine, and it did improve the stickiness of the mat.  But I also bought the #2 and #3 rated mats: Jade Harmony  and Lululemon Reversible, and both of these mats were great right out of the package, so you might want to try either of those instead.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 11, 2016
reviews.author: Susan H

reviews.title: you want this.  you won't regret it.
reviews.body: YUMMY mat!!  While, not quite as thick as the pro black, it is plenty to pad these old knees.  I don't just hate toting about my pro black, but the small difference in thickness equals a big difference in weight and bulkiness, so I have come to prefer this one for going places.  I find myself using this one any time my daughter isn't going to class with me.  The color is fab, too.  both this and the pro black seem to be lifetime mats.  They are still like new- only stickier.  About the break in period...I did nothing to either mat.  Yes, they are a little slick at first, but quickly got sticky with no treatment.  From the very first were the best mats I've ever used.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on September 16, 2016
reviews.author: MamaC
